g.text: Railings 2.2 m high at both edges (lunar gravity). Lanes' voids are railed and bridged. Trees and plants are placeholders: the Open Moon's plants are not yet designed.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: Orchards and kitchen gardens; open to everyone. Air 8.9 °C, steady. Unrolled as the hall-level sheet.
Summit port · ring 0 · design proposal (artistic), structure informed by the tower study's hand sizing · 28 September 2026
